block.goal: Move the cohesive tokenizer/builder cluster (StrTokenizer, StrMatcher, StrBuilder) into an internal subpackage to reduce package god component size.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.text.internal to host tokenizer/builder related classes.
Move StrTokenizer to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.internal to group tokenization logic with related helper classes.
Move StrMatcher to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.internal so matcher implementations reside with tokenizer and builder.
Move StrBuilder to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.internal to keep string construction utilities alongside tokenizer/matcher.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
